meaning.en: The newest CPython release in the list that is not free-threaded; on Linux and macOS it can be a pre-release
meaning.zh: 列表中最新的非自由线程版 CPython 版本；在 Linux 和 macOS 上可能是预发布版

meaning.en: The newest 3.13.x release, never a free-threaded or pre-release build
meaning.zh: 最新的 3.13.x 版本，不包括自由线程版和预发布版
最新的 3.13.x 自由线程版

help.en: A mirror of www.python.org/ftp/python, for the Windows installers and for the source archives of a source build. The list of versions still comes from the pyenv index, or from python.org on Windows. On Linux and macOS, a mirror keeps CPython on a source build unless the uv-build mirror is set too.
help.zh: www.python.org/ftp/python 的镜像，用于 Windows 安装包，以及源码构建所用的源码包。版本列表仍来自 pyenv 索引，Windows 上则来自 python.org。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，设置镜像后 CPython 会走源码构建，除非同时设置 uv-build 镜像。

help.en: By default, on Linux and macOS, a CPython release that the uv-build index lists installs as a prebuilt archive, and the others are built from source. Windows keeps the python.org installers. 0: build from source on Linux and macOS. 1: uv-build only, on every platform; a release the index does not list is an error.
help.zh: 默认情况下，在 Linux 和 macOS 上，uv-build 索引列出的 CPython 版本安装预编译的压缩包，其余版本从源码构建；Windows 保持使用 python.org 安装包。0：在 Linux 和 macOS 上从源码构建。1：所有平台都只使用 uv-build，索引没有列出的版本会报错。

name.en: Source build on Linux and macOS
name.zh: Linux 和 macOS 上从源码构建

help.en: A mirror of the GitHub releases of python-build-standalone, where the uv-build archives come from. The index and its checksums still come from vault.vfox.dev.
help.zh: python-build-standalone 在 GitHub 发布页的镜像，uv-build 压缩包从这里下载。索引和校验和仍来自 vault.vfox.dev。

help.en: On Linux the plugin detects glibc and musl itself. Set this only where detection is wrong or fails: uv-build then takes the build for gnu or musl. Without a known C library, the default install method builds from source.
help.zh: 在 Linux 上，插件会自行识别 glibc 与 musl。只有识别错误或失败时才需要设置：uv-build 会改用 gnu 或 musl 版本。无法识别 C 库时，默认安装方式会改为源码构建。

help.en: Installs are registered with the Python launcher, so that py -0p lists them. Set it to 0 to turn the registration off.
help.zh: 安装的 Python 会注册到 Python 启动器，使 py -0p 能够列出它们。设为 0 则关闭注册。

guide.en: A version is a CPython release as the list shows it, such as 3.12.2, 3.14.0a4 or 3.14.0a4t. A partial name such as 3.12 installs the newest release of that line; GraalPy is named in full, such as graalpy-24.2.0.
guide.zh: 版本就是列表里显示的名称，如 3.12.2、3.14.0a4 或 3.14.0a4t。3.12 这样的部分版本号会安装该版本线上最新的版本；GraalPy 要写完整名称，如 graalpy-24.2.0。

tips.en: On Linux and macOS, uv-build installs the CPython releases its index lists; others are built from source.
tips.zh: 在 Linux 和 macOS 上，uv-build 直接安装索引列出的 CPython 版本，其他版本从源码构建。

tips.en: A partial name without t never selects a free-threaded build or a pre-release.
tips.zh: 不带 t 的部分版本号既不会选中自由线程版，也不会选中预发布版。

tips.en: With uv-build only, GraalPy cannot be installed.
tips.zh: 选择“仅 uv-build”时无法安装 GraalPy。

tips.en: On Windows, installers come from python.org.
tips.zh: 在 Windows 上，安装包来自 python.org。

tips.en: A linked Python keeps its source in its name, such as 3.12.3-system.
tips.zh: 链接的 Python 会在名称中保留来源，如 3.12.3-system。

tips.en: GITHUB_TOKEN raises the GitHub rate limit.
tips.zh: 设置 GITHUB_TOKEN 或 GH_TOKEN 可以提高 GitHub 的访问速率限制。

title.en: Use a Python that is already installed
